<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/credit_runway"}
#docs
Counts what an active automatic top-up can still add this month. `runway_days` is null with under 24 hours of usage or no spend. An estimate.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | The customer's id (cus_…). |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `currency` | `string` | no | The balance currency. Default: the customer's. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `credit_runway`. One of `credit_runway`. |
| `customer` | `string` | cus_… |
| `currency` | `string` | ISO 4217. |
| `estimate` | `boolean` | The credit runway's estimate. One of `true`. |
| `runway_days` | `integer` | Whole days. Null: not enough usage to estimate. |
| `runs_out_at` | `string` | ISO 8601. |
| `balance_minor` | `integer` | Live credit balance. |
| `burn_minor_per_day` | `integer` | Spend in the last 7 days ÷ 7. |
| `spend_last_7_days_minor` | `integer` | Rated usage in the last 7 days. |
| `auto_topup_minor` | `integer` | What an active automatic top-up can still add this month. |
| `message` | `string` | The estimate in words. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The runway estimate. |
| `404` | No such customer. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/credit_runway" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
